title: Austin's New Leaders Sworn In with LBJ
summary:
*   **New Leadership Takes Office:** Roy Butler was inaugurated as the new Mayor, alongside a newly sworn-in slate of six council members.
*   **Mayor Pro-Tem Elected:** The new council unanimously elected Dan Love to serve as the Mayor Pro-Tem.
*   **High-Profile Guests:** The inauguration ceremony was attended by notable figures including former President Lyndon B. Johnson and then-Governor Preston Smith.
*   **Honoring Outgoing Officials:** Plaques were awarded to outgoing Mayor Travis LaRue and several former councilmen in recognition of their public service.
